families.status_basis: RC28-F18 names the deontic families; the norm-rule intermediate representation that would carry them is deferred by TSG-005 (lifecycle [deferred]) and has no section 3 term row.
families.what_it_must_separate: a duty to act from permission to act and from prohibition of the act

fail_closed_boundary.unknown_outcome: Unknown: no proven source span establishes a duty
fail_closed_boundary.conflict_outcome: Conflict: two anchors disagree on whether a duty exists

families.status_basis: RC28-F18 names permission as its own family; TSG-005 leaves the surrounding norm-rule representation [deferred] and no section 3 term row exists for it.
families.what_it_must_separate: an entitlement from the mere absence of a prohibition and from a duty

fail_closed_boundary.unknown_outcome: Unknown: no proven source span establishes permission
fail_closed_boundary.conflict_outcome: Conflict: two anchors disagree on whether the act is permitted

families.status_basis: RC28-F18 names prohibition as its own family; TSG-005 leaves the surrounding norm-rule representation [deferred] and no section 3 term row exists for it.
families.what_it_must_separate: a ban from the absence of a duty and from permission

fail_closed_boundary.unknown_outcome: Unknown: no proven source span establishes a ban
fail_closed_boundary.conflict_outcome: Conflict: two anchors disagree on whether the act is banned

families.status_basis: RC28-F18 requires a definitional family, but section 3 carries no definitional norm row and TSG has no dedicated definition gap: the honest status is no_owning_row, not a minted term.
families.what_it_must_separate: a definitional norm from an obligation and from a condition

fail_closed_boundary.unknown_outcome: Unknown: no proven source span establishes a definitional norm
fail_closed_boundary.conflict_outcome: Conflict: two anchors disagree on what a term is defined as

families.status_basis: TSG-007 (competence, delegation and normative hierarchy evidence graph) carries current lifecycle [proposed] under ADR-0019, so the family ceiling is proposed, not bounded.

fail_closed_boundary.unknown_outcome: Unknown: no proven source span establishes a competence
fail_closed_boundary.conflict_outcome: Conflict: two anchors disagree on which body is competent

fail_closed_boundary.unknown_outcome: Unknown: no proven source span establishes a guard
fail_closed_boundary.conflict_outcome: Conflict: two anchors disagree on the guard content

families.status_basis: Section 3 Exception / Defeater row: possible future NormRule exception or defeat roles, no active schema, vocabulary status deferred-undefined.
families.what_it_must_separate: an exception or defeater from a condition and from a scope limitation

fail_closed_boundary.unknown_outcome: Unknown: no proven source span establishes a defeat

families.status_basis: Section 3 Event time row: not a closed domain term, must be qualified by one of the five clock roles, vocabulary status qualified-view only, which maps to proposed.
families.what_it_must_separate: the time a norm is qualified to from the time a fact occurred and from publication

fail_closed_boundary.unknown_outcome: Unknown: the qualification is not proven, so the norm is not applied in time
fail_closed_boundary.conflict_outcome: Conflict: two anchors disagree on the governing time

negative_distinctions.non_claim: Nothing in this register lets a missing duty be read as a ban, or a ban as a missing duty.
An unproven claim stays Unknown; absence of a proven source span is never falsity.

non_claims: This register is not an adoption of normative semantics: no family, status or boundary here is accepted.
It is non-authoritative: it cannot satisfy a requirement, promote a lifecycle, close a gap row or establish legal correctness.
No runtime surface exists or is promised: there is no normative IR, no rule graph and no applicability evaluator.
The source-family axis is a corpus denominator axis of N to M provenance, not an IR family.
The vocabulary statuses are copied from the owning sources; a change there invalidates this register until it is re-derived.
Definition is recorded as no_owning_row: the absence of a section 3 row is a declared gap, not a minted term.
revision_policy: Re-derive before use: S02 must re-hash every source_binding and owning_source path, re-read each status from section 3 and the gap register, and re-bind this register before showing it; no timestamp and no aggregate engine hash are stored here.
